claim_boundary: Computed from aligned 8-bit SHDocs SDK exports. Values diagnose dataset consistency but do not calibrate the FLIR camera or establish an absolute AoLP convention.
interpretation: The orthogonal-pair residual is low enough to proceed with result-level four-direction proxy experiments.
The mean DoLP is weak, so OCR complementarity cannot be assumed and must be measured directly.
SDK s0_norm is almost perfectly correlated with the project-computed S0 but may use a different normalization scale.
